calculation.description: For assets with positive 20-session trend confirmation, rank the negative 60-session volatility-normalized return; unconfirmed assets receive the lowest score. Higher values indicate stronger slow reversal preference among confirmed assets.

validation.regime_notes: Positive 10-day IC in both evaluated recent regimes. Small 15-instrument cross-section requires conservative interpretation; early dates are unavailable due to 60-session warm-up and confirmation condition.
